name: KEI Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1968, KEI Industries Ltd manufactures wires and cables (W&C) like EHV cables, HT cables, LT cables, and sells them in India and overseas[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures and markets Extra-High Voltage (EHV), Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) power cables. It caters to retail and institutional markets and also provides Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 22.1% CAGR over last 5 years
